acceptance: A round that meets no new ask returns cap before the round limit (red test first)
Retry carries exactly the ids of the unmet required asks
Pass needs each required ask met with resolved evidence; an optional unmet ask does not block pass
The handoff package note documents the exits

summary: Component H4 of ADR-0141. go/internal/handoff/exit: a pure function of the request, the check results, the round history and the policy that returns pass, retry (with the ids of the unmet asks) or cap. Cap when the redispatch cap is spent or when a round meets no new ask. Pass only when each required ask is met with resolved evidence; a stated confidence never counts.
